title: Non-sargable DATE predicate
query: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = DATE '2026-05-18';
setup_sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_created_at ON orders(created_at);
description: An appropriate created_at index already exists, but DATE(created_at) makes the predicate non-sargable. SafeDBA should propose REWRITE_QUERY rather than another index.
